title: Wonders of Western Europe | Group Tour Package
highlights: Experience a seamless Europe journey where alpine landscapes, iconic cities, scenic drives, and cultural landmarks come together for an unforgettable journey.
Ride the world’s first revolving Rotair cable car to Mount Titlis, soaking in 360° views of snow-clad peaks, glaciers, and thrilling alpine scenery.
Admire the grandeur of Cologne Cathedral, a UNESCO-listed Gothic masterpiece famed for its soaring twin spires and intricate medieval architecture.
Listen to the powerful roar of Rhine Falls, Europe’s largest waterfall, where immense, thundering cascades create a truly spectacular and unforgettable natural display.
Cruise along the scenic Seine River, admiring Paris’s iconic landmarks from the water as the city’s timeless charm unfolds around you.
overview:
About the Tour
Discover the best of Europe on this unforgettable journey. Begin in Zurich, enjoying leisure time amid medieval charm, museums, and elegant shopping streets. Travel through the alpine beauty of Grindelwald and Interlaken, with an optional visit to Jungfraujoch. Experience Swiss innovation at Mount Titlis via the Rotair cable car and Cliff Walk, followed by Lucerne’s highlights. Witness the mighty Rhine Falls, explore the Black Forest, and continue to Frankfurt. Journey onward to Amsterdam via Cologne Cathedral, enjoying windmills, canals, and city sights. End in Paris with a guided city tour, Eiffel Tower visit, Seine cruise, and a leisure day to explore or visit Disneyland, before flying home with unforgettable memories.

know_before_you_go: Group airport pickup from Zurich Airport (ZRH) operates at 10:30 AM, 3:00 PM, and 8:00 PM on Day 1, and airport drop to Paris (CDG) is fixed at 10:00 AM on Day 10; guests arriving outside these timings may experience waiting time or need to arrange private transfers at additional cost.
Schengen visa, travel insurance, and VFS/embassy charges are not included in the package cost and must be arranged by guests separately; applicable GST and TCS are charged as per government norms.
Standard hotel check-in is at 4:00 PM and check-out is at 10:00 AM; early check-in or late check-out is subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed.
Rooms are generally twin-sharing; triple occupancy rooms usually include a sofa bed or rollaway bed, and a maximum of three guests are allowed per room.
All sightseeing is conducted as per the itinerary, and the order of visits may change due to weather conditions, ticket availability, or operational requirements.
Meals are provided as mentioned in the itinerary; Jain meals are available on request, and packed meals may be provided in case of delays.
Guests must be punctual at all meeting points; any loss due to late arrival, missed transfers, or sightseeing will be borne by the guest.
Coaches do not have washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging points, and eating hot or greasy food inside the coach or hotel rooms is strictly not permitted.
Pickpocketing is common in Europe; guests are responsible for their own belongings, passport, and valuables, and the company will not be involved in related legal proceedings.

Disneyland Paris is an optional activity available at an additional cost; guests who opt for Disneyland will spend the day at the park, while those not opting will have leisure time in Paris and will be provided a packed dinner on the same day.
During the Tulip season (19 March to 10 May), you will visit the Tulip Garden; outside this period, you will visit Zaanse Schans instead.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Zurich | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Zurich! Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel and complete the check-in process. The rest of the day is free for you to relax or explore the city on your own. You can head out to visit the charming Rapperswil Castle, known for its medieval architecture, or explore the Swiss National Museum to discover Switzerland’s rich heritage under one roof. Alternatively, you can take a leisurely walk along Bahnhofstrasse, one of Europe’s most elegant shopping streets.

days.title: Day Trip to Grindelwald & Interlaken
days.desc: Today, get driven to the scenic alpine village of Grindelwald, known for its breathtaking mountain views. Spend some relaxed time exploring Swiss cafés and local shops. You may also opt for an optional visit to Mount Jungfraujoch, the famous “Top of Europe,” offering snow-covered landscapes and icy vistas. Later, get driven to Interlaken and enjoy a leisurely walk through its charming streets. Also, you can visit the Yash Raj Monument before getting driven to your hotel in Zurich.

days.title: Day Trip to Mount Titlis | Lucerne Orientation Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to Engelberg for an unforgettable journey to Mount Titlis. Board the world’s first revolving Rotair cable car, a unique Swiss engineering marvel offering 360° views of snow-covered peaks, glaciers, and deep valleys. At the summit, walk across the thrilling Titlis Cliff Walk, Europe’s highest suspension bridge, and soak in the breathtaking alpine scenery. Later, get driven to Lucerne for an orientation tour, visiting the iconic Lion Monument and the historic Chapel Bridge.

days.title: Visit to Rhine Falls & Black Forest | Transfer to Frankfurt
days.desc: Today, check out from the hotel and enjoy a scenic drive to Frankfurt. En route, make a stop at Schaffhausen to witness the powerful Rhine Falls, one of Europe’s largest waterfalls, where cascading waters create an unforgettable sight. Continue toward the Black Forest, known for its dense pine forests, storybook villages, and traditional cuckoo clocks. Then, continue your journey to Frankfurt and upon your arrival, check-in to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Amsterdam | En Route Visit Cologne Cathedral
days.desc: Post check-out, set out on your journey to Amsterdam. En route, make a stop at Cologne & visit the iconic Cologne Cathedral, a Gothic masterpiece and UNESCO World Heritage Site, admired for its soaring twin spires and detailed architecture. Also, take time to explore its grand interiors and learn about its centuries-old history. Later, continue your drive toward Amsterdam. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax, enjoying a comfortable overnight stay in Amsterdam.

days.title: Visit to Zaanse Schans Windmills | Amsterdam City Tour | Amsterdam Canal Cruise
days.desc: Today, get driven to Zaanse Schans, a scenic village known for its traditional windmills, cheese factory, and wooden clog-making demonstrations. Spend some relaxed time enjoying the calm Dutch countryside. Later, get driven back to Amsterdam for a city tour covering Dam Square, the Royal Palace, and Nieuwe Kerk, giving a glimpse of the city’s culture and history. Conclude the day with a peaceful canal cruise before getting driven to the hotel for an overnight stay in Amsterdam.

days.title: Transfer to Paris | En-route Brussels Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Check out and get driven to Paris. En route, make a stop at Brussels & explore the beautiful Grand Place, one of Europe’s most impressive squares, surrounded by historic buildings and the medieval Town Hall. See the famous Manneken Pis statue and drive past St. Michael’s Church. Enjoy a photo stop at the iconic Atomium, a symbol of modern Brussels. Later, continue your drive to Paris. Upon arrival, check in to the hotel and relax with an overnight stay in Paris.

items.title: Check-in at Super Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: Hampton by Hilton Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport

days.title: Paris City Tour | Visit to Eiffel Tower | Seine Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, embark on a city tour of Paris, exploring iconic landmarks such as Place de la Concorde, Alexander Bridge, Les Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, and Champs Elysees. Later, visit the iconic Eiffel Tower and ascend to the 2nd level for breathtaking panoramic views of the city. Later, get driven to Port de la Bourdonnais for a relaxing cruise along the Seine River, admiring Paris’s most celebrated sights from the water. After the amazing experience, get driven to the hotel.

items.title: Paris Orientation Tour - Paris Highlights Orientation Tour

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, spend your day at leisure, where you can visit the famous Disneyland Paris for a magical adventure filled with thrilling rides, enchanting shows, and unforgettable moments with beloved Disney characters. Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere that brings fairy tales to life for all ages. Alternatively, you may choose leisure time to relax or explore Paris at your own pace, indulging in shopping and soaking in the city’s charm.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end to your amazing Europe trip!
